evidence: The two pairs of precursors pulsed in each deposition cycle were H2O/HfCl4 (hafnium tetrachloride) and H2O/TMA (trimethylaluminum), for depositing HfO2 and Al2O3, respectively. By using nitrogen (flow rate ~800 sccm!) as both the carrier and purging gas, gas phase reactions between precursors are prevented.
